operations.name: autosave.discard
operations.description: Discard all orphaned recovery slots that were discovered but are not yet restored, without opening them.

operations.name: autosave.flush
operations.description: Write any pending autosave state to local storage immediately (normally it waits for ~5s of idle). Returns the number of documents saved.

operations.name: autosave.recover
operations.description: Restore all orphaned recovery slots that were discovered but are not yet restored into new tabs. Returns the number of documents recovered, or 0 when none are pending.

operations.name: autosave.status
operations.description: Local autosave status: whether it is supported, pending unsaved documents, per-document slot ids and last-save times, and any orphaned recovery slots discovered but not yet restored.
